requirement_text.REQ-358: Extend the UAT scenario YAML schema with a scope field and step-level `when:` branching (eq/in/else only). Add a schema-validation mix task rejecting malformed scope/branching scenario files with a clear error. Backward compatible: every existing scenario file still parses unchanged. The branching construct must be proven sufficient for a login-routing example (role=PLATFORM_ADMIN / role=<tenant-role> / unauthenticated, three distinct outcomes).
